mapper.select: WITH device_batch AS ( SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.sn, d.product_code, d.product_name, d.location_snapshot, d.conp_type, d.conp_version, d.warranty_start_date, d.warranty_end_date, nv.boot_version, nv.cpld_version FROM ast_device d LEFT JOIN ast_device_network_version nv ON nv.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND nv.device_sn=d.sn AND nv.deleted=0 AND nv.source_system='DEVICE_LOG' AND (nv.sync_status IS NULL OR nv.sync_status<>'NOT_AVAILABLE') WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.sn=#{query.sn} AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.name},'%') AND d.product_code=#{query.productCode} AND d.id<#{query.beforeId} ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.limit} ), renewal_counts AS ( SELECT wr.device_sn, COUNT(*) AS extended_count FROM ast_device_warranty_record wr JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sn FROM device_batch) b ON b.sn=wr.device_sn WHERE wr.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND wr.deleted=0 AND wr.extended=1 GROUP BY wr.device_sn ) SELECT b.*, COALESCE(r.extended_count,0) AS extended_count FROM device_batch b LEFT JOIN renewal_counts r ON r.device_sn=b.sn ORDER BY b.device_id DESC
